contents.text: What happens when light absorbs into an object?

textContent.text: Light is a form of energy. When light is absorbed by an object, the energy isn't destroyed. Instead, the energy from the light is transformed into another form of energy.
For example, when sunlight is absorbed by solar panels, the light energy is transformed into heat energy and electrical energy.

contents.text: What happens when light absorbs into an object?

textContent.text: Light is a form of energy. When light is absorbed by an object, the energy isn't destroyed. Instead, the energy from the light is transformed into another form of energy.
For example, when sunlight is absorbed by solar panels, the light energy is transformed into heat energy and electrical energy.

. Refraction happens when light passes into or out of a material and changes direction, or refracts.
